prompt: Create a NEW original transparent facial-feature decal atlas for anime-style low-poly 3D fantasy game characters. Wide 2:1 canvas with exactly 4 columns and 2 rows of equal square cells, eight complete feature sets total. This is clean flat ANIME CEL ART, not realistic painting, not dolls, not photographs. Each cell contains ONLY two eyes, two narrow eyebrows, one tiny nose mark, and one tiny mouth line, floating on completely transparent alpha. NO skin, face shape, head, hair, neck or cheeks. Elegant restrained adult anime features, like small 3D fantasy tactics-game face textures. Eyes: tapered dark-brown upper lash stroke, fine understated lower stroke, ivory sclera, a simple solid oval iris with exactly two flat color tones, dark pupil and one small white catchlight. No eyelids painted in skin tones, no eyelashes rendered as hairs, no realistic iris texture. Eyebrows: single slim tapered brown shapes. Nose: ONE tiny angled warm-brown line, not a shaded nose, no nostrils, no skin-colored triangle. Mouth: ONE short delicate warm-brown curved line, at most one subtle thin rose accent below; no actual lips, no lip volume, no gloss, no teeth. Top four feminine, lower four masculine with slightly narrower eyes and firmer brows; neutral calm expression. Top iris colors left to right gray-blue, chestnut, muted violet, amber. Bottom iris colors left to right hazel, slate-gray, moss-green, dark-brown. Within every cell, eyebrows at 28 percent height; eye centers at x=29 percent and x=71 percent, y=39 percent; tiny nose line centered at y=60 percent; tiny mouth centered at y=74 percent, only 13 percent of cell width. Each eye width 26 percent of cell width, eye height 13 percent. All eight sets have identical alignment. Ample transparent gutters and transparent gaps between ALL features. Real alpha transparency with clean antialiased edges: no colored mask remnants, no background, no red/yellow halos, no opaque skin fields, no checkerboard. No text, labels, borders, logos, grid lines. All features original, no existing characters.
